why: The only shot GroupLab sheet published in this repository. It ships in the Windows package so a tester can open a real sheet and see an analysis, and the package's self-test analyses it. PROVENANCE.md beside this file is the consent record; no consent record, no publication.

consent.role: shot the sheet, scanned it, owns the copyright in the scan
consent.givenHow: in writing to the planning session, recorded in docs/NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 120 section 9
consent.statement: Use scan 3 as the sample scan. I dont care about my load data being shared.
consent.covers: this file only; every other scan and photograph from that range day stays private
consent.licence: GPL-3.0, as the rest of this repository

pixels.how: SHA-256 of the decoded 8-bit BGR pixel buffer as OpenCV reads it, 4958 by 6458 by 3 bytes

locationData: none: a flatbed scanner records none, and the text chunks were empty before they were dropped
sheet: GL-CF25-LTR-D, GroupLab's own 5 by 5 load development sheet with a load block

groundTruth.aimedAt: one shot at each of bulls 1 to 25
groundTruth.loadBlockAsWritten: 9/20/26, 100 y, 6.5 Creedmoor, 153.5 LRHT, 42.4 H4350, Alpha SRP brass, primer GM205MAR, 2.874
groundTruth.loadBlockCorrection: the primer was 7.5BR, not the GM205MAR written on the sheet; the sheet is published as it is and the correction is recorded here
groundTruth.expectedOfGroupLab: 25 holes on 25 bulls, one each, registering from the sheet's own printed markers

markers.where: 0.512 in from the left, 9.142 in down: the lower left, above the load block
markers.why: printed with horizontal white streaks across it, the printer's banding, so its black border is not a closed square and the detector finds no quad there. No hole is near it. Every other marker reads, and the sheet registers at 0.0026 in.
markers.measured: entry 164 section 2: 33 of 34 on Windows and on macOS from the same file, and SampleMarkerTests holds it on all three operating systems CI runs on
